parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
$0.025\text{ mol of HI(g)}$ is added to a closed vessel and left to reach dynamic equilibrium. The total pressure of the vessel is $100\text{ kPa}$.

equation 1 $$2\text{HI(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{H}_2\text{(g)} + \text{I}_2\text{(g)}$$
parts.text: Explain what is meant by dynamic equilibrium.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Describe **one** difference in the initial appearance of the reaction mixture compared to the mixture at equilibrium.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Write an expression for $K_{\text{p}}$ for the reaction described in equation **1**.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text:
At equilibrium the partial pressure of $\text{HI(g)}$ is $86.4\text{ kPa}$.

Calculate the amount of $\text{HI(g)}$ present in the mixture at equilibrium. Show your working.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Use equation **1** and the bond energy values in Table 3.1 to calculate the change in enthalpy, $\Delta H$, for the thermal decomposition of 1 mole of $\text{HI(g)}$. Show your working.

**Table 3.1**

| bond | bond energy/$\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| $\text{H-H}$ | 436 |
| $\text{I-I}$ | 151 |
| $\text{H-I}$ | 299 |

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe the effect of increasing pressure on the value of $K_{\text{p}}$ for the decomposition of $\text{HI(g)}$.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
$\text{HCl(g)}$ is prepared by adding $\text{NaCl(s)}$ to concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$.

$\text{HI(g)}$ is **not** prepared by adding $\text{NaI(s)}$ to concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ because the $\text{HI(g)}$ produced also reacts with concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$.
parts.text: Identify the type of reaction that occurs when $\text{NaI(s)}$ reacts with concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ to form $\text{HI(g)}$.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction of $\text{HI(g)}$ and concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Explain why $\text{HI(g)}$ reacts with concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ whereas $\text{HCl}$ does not.
